name: Danger Zone
effect: Blast damage is increased by 75% against targets within 3 metres of the detonation.

name: Street Sweeper
effect: Every detonation creates 75% more fragments.

name: Lunch Bell
effect: After a successful throw, gain 40% reload speed for 5 seconds.

name: Semtax
effect: Sticks to the 1st object it hits, including enemies and scenery, and remains attached until its fuse expires.

name: Little Lemon
effect: Every detonation creates 100% more fragments.

name: Red Notice
effect: Fragment hits that damage flesh also cause a heavy bleed.

name: Iron Curtain
effect: After a successful throw, take 90% less damage from grenade blasts and fragments for 8 seconds.

name: Blast Em
effect: The entire blast radius deals full blast damage.

name: Side Business
effect: The explosion also creates an instant smoke cloud at the detonation point for 15 seconds.

name: M.I.R.V.
effect: On detonation, releases 3 normal F-1 grenades in a wide, unpredictable spread.

name: Baseball
effect: +100% throwing distance and +50% explosion radius.

name: Holy Hand Grenade
effect: The fuse lasts 3 seconds. Explosion radius is increased by 300%.

name: Reset
effect: After a successful throw, gain 75% magazine loading and unloading speed for 10 seconds.

name: Rapid Response
effect: After a successful throw, your next firearm draw is 100% faster.

name: Juggernaut
effect: The thrower takes no damage from this grenade’s blast or fragments.

name: Ankle Biter
effect: Blast damage to legs is increased by 75%.

name: Dirty Work
effect: After a successful throw, hip-fire dispersion is reduced by 40% for 6 seconds.

name: Encore
effect: Detonates on impact, then repeats the full explosion at the same location after 1 second.

name: Point Blank
effect: An enemy directly struck by the grenade takes 100% more blast damage from its detonation.

name: Big Bang
effect: +30% explosion radius. Every detonation also produces a flash effect within 25 metres.

name: Small Claims
effect: Gain 60% more blast damage when a pistol is your only equipped firearm at release.

name: Shagbag
effect: Maximum 15 charges per copy and +50% throwing distance.

name: Sun Staring Champion
effect: The thrower is immune to this grenade’s flash, concussion and deafening effects.

name: Play Maker
effect: After a successful throw, gain 20% movement speed for 5 seconds.

name: Daylight Robbery
effect: Enemies successfully flashed take 30% more damage from your firearm shots for 8 seconds.

name: Neuralyzer
effect: +100% effective flash radius.

name: Flash Push
effect: Successfully flashing an enemy grants 40% less firearm recoil for 8 seconds.

name: Fog of War
effect: Smoke cloud width, height and depth are increased by 100%.

name: Safe Passage
effect: While within 8 metres of this grenade’s active smoke source, the thrower gains 20% movement speed.

name: Still Waters
effect: While crouched within 8 metres of this grenade’s active smoke source, the thrower has 60% less firearm recoil.

name: Pop Smoke
effect: Smoke instantly reaches its full area when the fuse expires.

name: FOB
effect: While within 8 metres of this grenade’s active smoke source, the thrower loads and unloads magazines 100% faster.

name: Green Room
effect: While within 8 metres of this grenade’s active smoke source, the thrower uses medical items 50% faster.

name: Breathing Room
effect: While within 8 metres of this grenade’s active smoke source, the thrower gains +75% Arm Stamina and Leg Stamina regeneration.

name: Trailblazer
effect: Drops 1 M18 Green smoke grenade immediately and 1 every 5 metres of horizontal travel. Drops stop on landing, where the parent deploys its normal cloud. Dropped grenades deploy smoke after landing.

name: Curtain Call
effect: Detonates on impact after a 0.3-second arming delay, then repeats the flash at the same location after 1 second. Has a 3-second backup fuse.

name: 9-Banger
effect: After the normal fuse, emits 9 flashes at the same location, 0.25 seconds apart. Each throw spends 1 charge.
